cohort: 369 women over 60 years old living in Tabas city, Iran
finding: The prevalence of urinary incontinence among the elderly women was 24.9%, and factors associated with UI included older age, higher BMI, constipation, history of cesarean section, hypertension, and use of angiotensin receptor blockers.
mod_finding: History of cesarean section was a factor increasing the odds of having UI.
